H1.rule: in each Qwen set, failures > 0 and the noop share strictly above every other type

H2.rule: failed str_replace per call, 30B minus 480B on the shared tasks (tasks resampled): 95% interval above 0

H3.rule: known_bad_retry_error_named_per_run: in every Qwen set with at least 30 eligible runs, the Clopper-Pearson 95% upper bound is below 0.10 (at least one such set)

H4.rule: circles_two_errors_both_named_per_run: in every Qwen set with at least 30 eligible runs, the Clopper-Pearson 95% upper bound is below 0.10 (at least one such set)

H5.rule: resolution rate with a no-op minus without, 95% interval below 0, in both OpenHands Qwen sets

H6.rule: dev point estimate inside the 95% interval of the held-out R2E-Gym runs, for failed_str_replace_per_call, noop_share_of_failures, runs_with_noop, runs_with_circle
